choice: Compare ancestry of full rooted occurrence histories by complete typed edge-list prefix. Keep endpoint selection/retraction explicitly lossy, with only its proved right-inverse/idempotence contracts.
premises: Same fixed root, complete actual source/target/edge trace and valid joins.
Occurrence reachability is existing Quiver.Reachable; endpoint/base reachability is a different relation.
Operational comparison additionally validates exact externally supplied source snapshot, raw taxonomy/revision, role/direction and ordered relation content/positions.
checked_limits: Distinct histories with same endpoint cannot be recovered by any endpoint decoder.
Projection/retraction of histories cannot supply missing ancestor reflection.
Synthetic cycle fixtures show identical endpoints/lengths do not decide exact runtime prefix.
open_obligations: Exact Lean/runtime relation-ID graph refinement; noncomputable math maps are not executable codecs.
215 method identities unprovided; source custody/taxonomy similarity is not proof authority.
authority: Durable local mathematical/design choice only. No permissions, remote effects or new authority from research documents.
